//ExStart
//ExSummary: This tutorial shows how to create a Word document, insert a column chart, clear its default data, and populate it with custom data from a two‑dimensional array—mapping each row to a series and each column to a category—then add a title and save the file.
//ExStepSummary:0: Create a new Document and a DocumentBuilder attached to it.
//ExStepSummary:1: Insert a column chart of size 432x252 points into the document and obtain its Chart object.
//ExStepSummary:2: Remove the automatically generated sample series from the chart.
//ExStepSummary:3: Define the X‑axis category labels and the legend entries for each series.
//ExStepSummary:4: Create a two‑dimensional array where each row holds the values for one series.
//ExStepSummary:5: Iterate over each series, extract its row values from the matrix, and add the series to the chart with the corresponding legend entry and X‑axis labels.
//ExStepSummary:6: Set the chart title text to 'Half‑Yearly Revenue' and make it visible.
//ExStepSummary:7: Save the document containing the custom chart to a .docx file.
//ExStepImage:1:images/1.png
//ExStepImage:2:images/2.png
//ExStepImage:5:images/3.png
//ExStepImage:6:images/4.png
//ExStep:0-
Document myDocument = new Document();
DocumentBuilder docBuilder = new DocumentBuilder(myDocument);

//ExStep:1-
Shape chartContainer = docBuilder.InsertChart(ChartType.Column, 432, 252);
Chart chartObj = chartContainer.Chart;

//ExStep:2-
chartObj.Series.Clear();

//ExStep:3-
string[] xLabels = { "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr" };
string[] legendEntries = { "Item Alpha", "Item Beta", "Item Gamma" };

//ExStep:4-
double[,] dataMatrix = {
    { 120.5, 135.0, 150.2, 165.3 }, // Item Alpha
    { 80.0,  95.5, 110.1, 130.0 }, // Item Beta
    { 60.3,  70.4,  85.6,  95.2 }   // Item Gamma
};

//ExStep:5-
for (int sIdx = 0; sIdx < legendEntries.Length; sIdx++)
{
    double[] rowValues = new double[xLabels.Length];
    for (int cIdx = 0; cIdx < xLabels.Length; cIdx++)
    {
        rowValues[cIdx] = dataMatrix[sIdx, cIdx];
    }

    chartObj.Series.Add(legendEntries[sIdx], xLabels, rowValues);
}

//ExStep:6-
chartObj.Title.Text = "Half‑Yearly Revenue";
chartObj.Title.Show = true;

//ExStep:7-
myDocument.Save("CustomChart.docx");
//ExEnd
